subject: Power Potion
text: Power Potions boost HP by 3-5.

evidence.quote: Power Potions boost HP by 3-5.

subject: Great Potion
text: Great Potions boost attack power (ATP) by 1-3, and are recommended for Aguro since he does not learn spells.

evidence.quote: I would recommend giving Great Potions to Aguro to boost his attack power (ATP) by 1-3, since he doesn't learn any spells.

subject: Spell Potion
text: Spell Potions boost MP by 3-5, and are recommended for the Hero due to expensive spells like Rally and Valor.

evidence.quote: I would give Spell potions (+3-5 MP) to the Hero, because he has the least MP, yet the most expensive and useful spells like Rally and Valor.

subject: Mind Potion
text: Mind Potions boost Intelligence (INT) by 1-3, increasing magic damage, and are recommended for Lufia.

evidence.quote: For Mind Potions, I would give them to Lufia to boost her Intelligence (INT, boosts magic damage) by 1-3, since she is the opposite of Aguro, using her magic nearly all the time.

subject: Speed Potion
text: Speed Potions boost Agility (AGL) by 1-3, and giving all of them to Jerin is strongly recommended.

evidence.quote: Mostly important, I strongly recommend giving all Speed potions (+1-3 AGL) to Jerin.

subject: Gades
text: Against Gades, Maxim and Guy should attack, Selan should cast Thunder every round, and Artea should cast Trick followed by Champion or Valor as needed.

evidence.quote: STRATEGY: Maxim and Guy should attack, while Selan casts Thunder every round. Artea should cast Trick to boost Maxim's & Guy's attack power, then either cast Champion (restore one ally to max HP) or Valor (restore all allies to max HP), as necessary.

subject: Amon
text: Against Amon, Maxim and Guy should attack while Selan and Artea cast and re-cast Mirror on the party to reflect his spells.

evidence.quote: STRATEGY: Maxim and Guy should attack every round, while Selan and Artea should cast Mirror on themselves, then the others.  They should be constantly re-casting Mirror to reflect Amon's spells back at him for the entire battle.
